items.prompt: Why do interior nodes have full weight but endpoints half weight in composite trapezoid?

options.text: Every node is counted exactly twice without halves
options.why: Endpoints belong to only one panel.

options.text: Interior nodes belong to two adjacent half-weighted panels
options.why: Summing the integrated straight-line panels yields the weights.

options.text: Interior points have guaranteed zero evaluation error
The rule automatically uses a probability distribution
options.why: The weights here come from panel geometry.

items.explanation: Each panel contributes h/2times each endpoint, so an interior shared node receives hwhile a global endpoint receives h/2.
